'''Vibroblade Brigade''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group hired by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] to bolster their [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|defense]] of [[Murkhana City/Legends|Murkhana City]] during the final days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their signature weapon, the [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], was an integral part of their image.

[[Idis]], who had been captured by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] squad [[Ion Team]], was a member of the Vibroblade [[Brigade/Legends|Brigade]].
